scientific_question: In the LOx-post flow field, define high-speed locations as those at or above the linearly interpolated 90th percentile of non-zero recorded speed on the stored velocity scale, and treat locations connected through immediate grid neighbors along one grid axis as one contiguous high-speed region. Which region is strongest when strength is measured by peak speed? Report its peak speed, locate it using the mean spatial location of its retained high-speed locations, and characterize it using at least one relevant aspect of your choice: geometric relation, meaningful comparison, morphology, orientation, or spatial extent.
